PORT.description: Public web and API proxy port.

PUBLIC_API_URL.description: Public origin for web client, OAuth callbacks and signed file links.

WORKSPACE_MODE.description: Live persistent workspace. Sample mode is not for public hosting.

AGENT_BACKEND.description: Agent harness: model for built-in provider, or agui with AGENT_URL.

DATA_DIR.description: Persistent documents and workspace signing key. Do not change without migrating the volume.

TASK_WORKER_ENABLED.description: Run durable background tasks in the API service.

COMPUTER_ENABLED.description: Linux desktop requires a Docker host and is unavailable on Railway. Browser automation remains enabled.

DATABASE_URL.description: Private PostgreSQL connection for workspace state.

CPK_INTELLIGENCE_API_KEY.description: Required CopilotKit Intelligence project key for durable conversations. Create a free project at platform.copilotkit.ai or run npx copilotkit@latest login and project select.

OPENMUSE_ACCESS_KEY.description: Generated workspace sign-in key. Copy this value from Variables to log in; keep it private.

TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Generated canonical base64 encryption key, exactly 32 bytes. Keep unchanged after connecting accounts.

WORKER_TOKEN.description: Shared authentication for the private browser worker.

MODEL.description: Optional model, e.g. openai/gpt-5.6-terra, anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6 or google/gemini-2.5-flash. Set the matching provider key. Blank starts the workspace without model chat.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional OpenAI or OpenAI-compatible provider key. Required when MODEL uses openai/.

OPENAI_BASE_URL.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible API base URL. Leave blank for OpenAI.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional Anthropic provider key for anthropic/ models.

GOOGLE_API_KEY.description: Optional Google provider key for google/ models.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional Google OAuth web-client ID for Gmail and Calendar. See overview for consent setup.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional Google OAuth client secret; configure with GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.

AGENT_URL.description: Optional remote AG-UI agent endpoint. Set AGENT_BACKEND=agui to use your own harness.

RAILWAY_RUN_UID.description: Entrypoint repairs volume ownership, then drops to the unprivileged node user.

PORT.description: Browser worker port and Railway healthcheck port.

WORKER_TOKEN.description: Generated private authentication token shared with OpenMuse.

RAILWAY_RUN_UID.description: Start as root only to repair the volume, then drop to pwuser.

deploy.startCommand: sh -c 'chown pwuser:pwuser /data && exec setpriv --reuid=pwuser --regid=pwuser --init-groups node --experimental-strip-types src/index.ts'

PGDATA.description: Location where the database will be initialized

PGDATABASE.description: Required variable for the data panel.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Default database created when image is started.

DATABASE_URL.description: URL to connect to Postgres database.

POSTGRES_USER.description: User to connect to Postgres DB

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Allow Postgres to cleanly shut down
